'''The Gauntlet: Dual Formats''' is a Star Wars CCG event format that starts as a constructed tournament and finishes with a sealed-deck event for the top eight. [[Decipher]] ran it as a sanctioned side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] for Star Wars CCG, ''Star Trek'' CCG and Young Jedi.<ref name="dc99-gauntlet">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thegauntletdualformats.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Descriptions: The Gauntlet: Dual Formats], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011005150619/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thegauntletdualformats.html Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' constructed, then sealed deck
* '''Defined by:''' Decipher (1999)
* '''Card pool:''' the normal constructed pool; then one Official Tournament Sealed Deck per finalist
* '''In use:''' 1999 (DecipherCon 1999)
* '''Also called:''' The Gauntlet Dual Format (Decipher's score sheet title on [[DecipherCon 1999 Gauntlet]])
* '''GEMP:''' none

== Card pool ==
Decipher's description: "All players bring standard constructed decks and compete as normal in a 4 game constructed tournament. At the end of those four rounds, the top 8 players progress into a special 3 game sealed deck event where they try to prove that it's player skill that makes them great, not just good decks!"<ref name="dc99-gauntlet" />
* Players bring standard constructed decks.
* Four constructed games with normal pairing and standard rules.
* The top 8 then play a 3-game sealed-deck final; "The Sealed Deck Format will be OTSD of 3 games duration", that is, the [[Enhanced Format Sealed Deck]] with the [[Official Tournament Sealed Deck]].
* It was sanctioned: constructed games counted toward constructed ratings and the top 8's sealed games toward sealed ratings. Free entry.<ref name="dc99-gauntlet" />

== History ==
DecipherCon 1999 scheduled the Star Wars Gauntlet (SW.30) on Thursday 11 November, 2–10 p.m., and Saturday 13 November, 9 p.m.–5 a.m.<ref name="dc99-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule (Thursday)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000122035723/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="dc99-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule (Saturday)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026023004/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html Internet Archive].</ref> Results are on [[DecipherCon 1999 Gauntlet]].
